RDAT.name: Data Header
RDAT.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas REGN wbRegionDataEntries: type (2 objects, 3 weather, 4 map, 5 land, 6 grass, 7 sound, 8 imposter), flags, priority; repeated, each followed by that type's data

RDID.name: Imposters
RDID.note: The region's imposter list: the references with the REFR XSRF Imposter flag that are drawn always while the player is in the region [documented: GECK wiki 'Reference', owner's export]. Observed in FalloutNV.esm: present only after an RDAT of type 8, in 18 regions (StripImposter lists 222 references, StripImposterClose 10), each entry a REFR FormID; the subrecord name is not checked against xEdit

RDMO.name: Music
RDMO.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas REGN sound data entry (RDMO, MUSC)

RDMP.name: Map Name
RDMP.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas REGN Map entry: wbString(RDMP, 'Map Name', 0, cpTranslate).SetDontShow(wbREGNMapDontShow). Verified: 55 instances in FalloutNV.esm, all NUL-terminated (e.g. 'Aerotech Office Park\0', 'North Vegas Square\0')

RDOT.name: Objects
RDOT.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas REGN Objects entry: wbArray(RDOT, 'Objects', wbStruct('Object', [wbFormIDCk('Object', [TREE, STAT, LTEX]), wbInteger('Parent Index', itU16, wbHideFFFF), wbUnused(2), wbFloat('Density'), wbInteger('Clustering', itU8), wbInteger('Min Slope', itU8), wbInteger('Max Slope', itU8), wbInteger('Flags', itU8, wbFlags([...])), wbInteger('Radius wrt Parent', itU16), wbInteger('Radius', itU16), wbFloat('Min Height'), wbFloat('Max Height'), wbFloat('Sink'), wbFloat('Sink Variance'), wbFloat('Size Variance'), wbStruct('Angle Variance', [itU16 X, Y, Z]), wbUnused(2), wbByteArray('Unknown', 4)])). Verified: every RDOT size in FalloutNV.esm is 52*n (52..520), plus one 0-byte and one 364 (7*52) case; no count prefix - the subrecord body is exactly N fixed-size elements (all sizes are multiples of 52)

RDSB.name: Battle MediaSet
RDSB.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas REGN sound data entry (repeated RDSB 'Battle MediaSets', MSET)

RDSD.name: Sounds
RDSD.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsCommon.pas wbRegionSounds: wbArrayS(RDSD, 'Sounds', wbStructSK([0], 'Sound', [wbFormIDCk('Sound', [SNDR, SOUN, NULL]), wbInteger('Flags', itU32, wbFlags([Pleasant, Cloudy, Rainy, Snowy])), wbFloat('Chance')])). Verified: every RDSD size in FalloutNV.esm is a multiple of 12 (12..828), matching a u32 count plus 12-byte elements; no count prefix - the subrecord body is exactly N fixed-size elements (all sizes are multiples of 12)

RDSI.name: Incidental MediaSet
RDSI.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas REGN sound data entry (RDSI, MSET)

RDWT.name: Weather Types
RDWT.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas REGN RDWT: weather, chance, global (as CLMT WLST)

RPLD.name: Region Points
RPLD.note: One area's polygon in worldspace units: x, y pairs [documented: xEdit wbRPLDAfterLoad reads each entry's two elements as numbers; observed: VMapGoodspringsRegion's six points span x -76216..-67372, y -6064..10250, around Goodsprings]

RPLI.name: Edge Fall-off
RPLI.note: Starts each region area, before its RPLD points (xEdit wbRegionAreas, not read here). Observed: u32 1024 in VMapGoodspringsRegion; the name is xEdit's [hypothesis: not checked against the source]
